needed.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, pedestrians must walk in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The narrow sidewalk on the right side is partly blocked by parked cars and other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Ensure the right-side sidewalk is clear of obstructions and widen it to at least 1 meter for safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the narrow sidewalk create trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the sidewalk on the right side to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: No proper crossing facility despite pedestrian demand
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing with proper signage and ensure it is visible to drivers.

needed.evidence: The marked crossing is poorly maintained and obstructed, making it unsafe for pedestrians
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the crossing to a signalised crossing with a refuge island to ensure safety for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the crossing, making it difficult for pedestrians with disabilities to cross
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate access for all pedestrians, including those with disabilities.
